# Buymeacoffee — Style Reference

> black ink on white butcher paper, with one yellow cup lid. Geometric Circular Bold headlines on a #ffffff canvas, hairline-free cards lifted by soft triple shadows, and a single #ffdd00 pill that does all the selling.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is a cup-lid-yellow creator-commerce language. The page sits on #ffffff Paper Canvas (35 background uses), with #faf8f0 Cream Tile behind illustrations, #2222220d Mist Well recessing the search field and #ffffffb3 Frosted Glass under the floating hero cards. The chromatic budget is exactly one: #ffdd00 appears only as the filled primary action pill. Terracotta #d8573f and sand #f7d046 are confined to product mockups that demonstrate a creator's page, so they never reach the brand's own chrome. Typography is one family, Circular, in Book, Regular, Medium and Bold cuts. Bold carries all hierarchy at 96px and 64px, with tracking pulled to -2.4px and -2px, while body copy sits at 400 in #222222 across 67 text uses. The 1.5 step between display sizes far outpaces the Major Third convention. Shapes run from 16px creator cards to 9999px capsules, and depth comes from one soft three-layer shadow recipe rather than borders. The page reads as a friendly storefront handing you a cup rather than a fintech dashboard asking for credentials.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sunbeam Action | `#ffdd00` | `--color-sunbeam-action` | Fill of the "Start my page" hero pill and the "Sign up" nav pill, also the logo's cup — the brand's entire chromatic budget in one hue. Do not use it for text, icons or section backgrounds. |
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background, creator cards, mockup panels and stat bubbles (35+ uses) — white is both floor and card, so shadow alone separates the two. |
| Cream Tile | `#faf8f0` | `--color-cream-tile` | Backdrops behind membership illustrations and quiet panels (7 uses) — a warm half-step off white that frames vector art without reading as a new section. |
| Frosted Glass | `#ffffffb3` | `--color-frosted-glass` | Anchor wrappers behind the six tilted hero creator cards (6 uses) — translucent white lets cards overlap the canvas softly instead of stamping hard edges. |
| Mist Well | `#2222220d` | `--color-mist-well` | Search-creators pill in the nav and recessed input fills — a 5% ink wash that sinks the field below the canvas plane, the opposite of elevation. |
| Ink | `#222222` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, body paragraphs, nav links and ghost button labels (67 text uses) — softened black keeps 96px Bold from feeling harsh against pure white. |
| Jet Heading | `#000000` | `--color-jet-heading` | Primary pill label, card wrapper text and select nav labels (17 uses) — true black reserved for text sitting on #ffdd00, where #222222 would lose contrast punch. |
| Graphite Caption | `#717171` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Uppercase section eyebrows, supporter counts, prices and placeholder text (22 uses) — the single secondary-text tone, so the hierarchy has exactly two greys. |
| Pebble Skeleton | `#e1e1e1` | `--color-pebble-skeleton` | Loading-bar placeholders inside the e-book mockup and divider ticks (2 uses) — decorative stand-in for content, not a border color. |
| Ash Hairline | `#2222221a` | `--color-ash-hairline` | The one measured hairline, a 1px divider at 10% ink — rationed to a single use because shadows, not lines, do the separating. |
| Ember Signal | `#d8573f` | `--color-ember-signal` | "Support $3" button, selected coffee-count circle and quantity rings inside the creator widget mockup — the demo page's accent. Do not promote it to the brand's primary CTA. |
| Ember Wash | `#d8573f0d` | `--color-ember-wash` | Tinted tray behind the coffee quantity selector in the mockup (4 uses) — a 5% ember wash that groups the picker without a heavy fill. |
| Sand Mock | `#f7d046` | `--color-sand-mock` | E-book cover block and "Buy" button inside the Shop mockup (2 uses) — a duller cousin of #ffdd00 that marks a creator's product, not a brand action. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Circular — the single voice, cut into four weights that carry every level of hierarchy · `--font-circular`

- **Substitute:** Figtree at 400 for Book/Regular, 500 for Medium and 700 for Bold (closest stroke match — Circular Book draws slightly heavier than its 400 label, and Figtree 400 meets it); DM Sans at 450 for body and 700 for display (DM Sans Bold sets a touch narrower, so keep tracking at the measured values rather than tightening further).
- **Weights:** 400 (Book and Regular cuts), 500 (Medium), 700 (Bold). The extraction reports every cut at 400 because each weight ships under its own family name.
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 22px, 24px, 30px, 40px, 64px, 96px
- **Line height:** 0.99 (96px), 1.07 (15px card copy), 1.2 (20px, 40px), 1.25 (64px), 1.333 (24px), 1.5 (12–22px body)
- **Letter spacing:** -2.4px at 96px, -2px at 64px, 2px at 16px uppercase eyebrows, 0px at every other size
- **Role:** Bold at 96px with -2.4px tracking and a 0.99 line-height is the signature — rounded geometric letters packed so tight the headline reads as one solid object. The jump from 64px to 96px is a 1.5 ratio, a Perfect Fifth that dwarfs the 1.25 Major Third most product sites climb by. Section intros drop to 24px Regular, so hierarchy is a cliff of size and weight together rather than a gentle ladder. The 2px-tracked uppercase eyebrow is the only positive tracking in the system, and it works as a whispered label above each shouting headline.

### ui-sans-serif — the inherited system stack on card wrappers, overridden by Circular inside · `--font-ui-sans-serif`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400, Roboto at 400 (both match the system UI stroke at regular weight)
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 16px, 20px, 24px, 40px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at all sizes
- **Role:** This is the Tailwind preflight default, which lands on anchor wrappers of the hero creator cards and a few mockup containers. It never renders as visible copy, because Circular sets every glyph the reader sees. Its presence signals a utility-CSS build in which the brand face is applied per element rather than inherited from the body. Treat it as a fallback rather than a voice.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Circular | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Circular | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Circular | 400 | 15px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Circular | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Circular | 400 | 22px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Circular | — | 24px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Circular | 700 | 40px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Circular | 700 | 64px | 1.25 | -2px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Circular | 700 | 96px | 0.99 | -2.4px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Spend #ffdd00 on exactly one filled action per viewport — the yellow capsule is the brand, and a second yellow element halves its pull.
- Set the hero headline in Circular weight 700 at 96px with -2.4px tracking and a 0.99 line-height — the near-solid block of letters is the page's identity.
- Open every section with a 16px weight 700 uppercase eyebrow tracked 2px in #717171, then a 64px weight 700 headline at -2px — this pairing is the non-negotiable section opener.
- Lift cards with the three-layer sm shadow (a 2px ring at 0.15 plus a 40px haze at 0.04) instead of a border — depth comes from atmosphere, not outlines.
- Keep #d8573f and #f7d046 inside product mockup cards with a 32px radius — they demonstrate a creator's page and stay quarantined from chrome.
- Round every action, avatar and input to 9999px and every product card to 32px — capsules act, soft rectangles hold content.
- Set body copy at weight 400 in #222222, 22px/1.5 for hero subtitles and 24px/1.333 for section intros — softened ink reads warmer than #000000 on white.

### Don't

- Don't color CTAs or links in a #1877f2-style blue — convention puts actions in blue, but here that blue is a third-party social mark and is not a system token.
- Don't wrap cards in a 1px #e1e1e1 border on top of the sm shadow — doubling the edge turns soft floating paper into boxed form fields.
- Don't set the 64px headline in weight 500 or at 0px tracking — loosened, lighter display type loses the dense, stamped quality that carries hierarchy.
- Don't paint whole sections in #faf8f0 — cream is rationed to illustration tiles (7 uses), and a cream page dilutes the white-and-ink contrast that frames the yellow.
- Don't make the brand's primary button #d8573f because the mockups use it — the brand owns one hue, and terracotta must never leave the demo.
- Don't square buttons off to 8px — the 9999px capsule is the action shape, and an 8px button reads as an image or input.
- Don't put the lg shadow (80px haze) on stat bubbles and nav elements — stacked large hazes fog the white canvas and flatten the floating hierarchy.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- primary text: #222222 (Ink)
- secondary text: #717171 (Graphite Caption)
- recessed input fill: #2222220d (Mist Well)
- illustration tile: #faf8f0 (Cream Tile)
- mockup-only accent: #d8573f (Ember Signal)
- primary action: #ffdd00 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and progress bars stay neutral, with series in #222222 and tracks in #e1e1e1, and at most one highlighted bar in solid #ffdd00 — so the accent marks the single number that matters and never becomes the loudest thing on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: a link styled as a capsule with background #ffdd00, text color #000000, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 18px 48px for a 72px total height, and the label "Start my page" in Circular (fallback Figtree 700) at 24px, weight 700, line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0px, with no shadow. Below it, centered with a 16px gap, add the line "It's free and takes less than a minute!" in Circular 14px weight 400, color #222222. Hover: keep #ffdd00 and add the sm shadow `0px 0px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 2px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`.

2. Build the hero section on a #ffffff background, centered text inside a 936px max-width column. Put a social proof row at the top: five star icons with an 8px gap, then "Loved by 2,000,000+ creators" in Circular 16px weight 400 #222222. Add 32px of space, then the h1 "Fund your creative work" in Circular 96px weight 700, line-height 0.99, letter-spacing -2.4px, color #222222, max two lines. Add 24px of space, then a subtitle in Circular 22px weight 400, line-height 1.5, #222222, max-width 600px. Add 32px of space, then the yellow 72px capsule button from prompt 1. Absolutely position six Floating Creator Cards, three per side, partially off-canvas and rotated between -6deg and 6deg.

3. Build a Floating Creator Card: an anchor wrapper with background #ffffffb3 and a 16px radius containing a div with background #ffffff, border-radius 16px, padding 9px 14px, width 200px, and box-shadow `0px 0px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 2px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`, with no border. Inside, centered, place a 48px circular avatar (radius 9999px), an 8px gap, then the creator line in Circular 15px weight 400 with line-height 16px in #222222, then an 8px gap and a heart line icon plus "9,138 supporters" in Circular 12px weight 400 #717171. Rotate the whole card 4deg.

4. Build the navigation bar: full-width, background #ffffff, height 72px, no border or shadow, with 48px horizontal padding and three zones. On the left, ghost links "FAQ", "Wall of ♥", "Apps" and "Resources", the last two with 12px chevrons, each with padding 8px 16px, Circular 16px weight 500, color #222222 and transparent background. In the center, the wordmark at 30px height. On the right, with a 16px gap: a search capsule with background #2222220d, radius 9999px, padding 12px 16px, height 48px, a magnifier icon and placeholder "Search creators" in Circular 14px #717171; a "Log in" ghost link; and a "Sign up" capsule with background #ffdd00, radius 9999px, padding 8px 16px, height 48px, Circular 16px weight 500, color #222222.

5. Build a Product Mockup Card: background #ffffff, border-radius 32px, padding 24px, width 384px, with box-shadow `0px 0px 3px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 11px 56px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 3px 7px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`. Set the title "Buy Juliet a coffee" in Circular 24px weight 700 #222222. Add 16px of space, then a selector tray with background #d8573f0d, a 1px #d8573f40 border and an 8px radius, holding three 40px circles with a 1px #d8573f border and #d8573f numerals in Circular 14px weight 500; the selected circle fills #d8573f with #ffffff text. Below that, an 8px-radius textarea on #2222220d with placeholder in #717171. Finish with a full-width 48px capsule, background #d8573f, label "Support $3" in Circular 16px weight 700 #ffffff.

### Pill Button — Yellow (Primary)

**Role:** The one place the brand spends color

**Role:** Centered-logo header with split utilities

A three-zone white header. It has a #ffffff background with no border or shadow and a 72px height (estimated) built from 48px controls inside 12px vertical padding. The left side holds ghost links "FAQ", "Wall of ♥", "Apps ▾" and "Resources ▾" in Circular 16px weight 500 #222222. The script wordmark with its #ffdd00 cup sits dead center. The right side holds a search pill, "Log in" and the yellow "Sign up" pill. Centering the logo breaks the left-aligned SaaS convention — it reads as a shopfront sign.

### Search Pill Input

**Role:** Recessed creator search in nav

A sunken capsule. It takes a #2222220d Mist Well fill, no border, 9999px radius, padding 12px 16px, a 48px height (estimated), a line magnifier icon in #717171 and placeholder "Search creators" in Circular 14px weight 400 #717171, with no shadow. It is the only element that sits below the canvas plane — recessed fills mean "type here" while shadows mean "look here".

### Section Eyebrow

**Role:** Category label above every headline

A tracked uppercase whisper. It has no background, #717171 text, Circular at 16px weight 700, 2px letter-spacing, uppercase, line-height 1, centered, with 16px of space before the 64px headline. Labels read "SUPPORT", "MEMBERSHIPS", "SHOP" and "POSTS, AUDIO & EMAIL". The pairing of tiny tracked grey with massive tight black is the section opener's rhythm — it carries the same structure four times down the page.

### Floating Creator Card

**Role:** Scattered social proof around hero

A tilted paper slip. It takes a #ffffff background over a #ffffffb3 Frosted Glass wrapper, no border, 16px radius, padding 9px 14px, the sm shadow, a 9999px avatar, the creator line in Circular 15px weight 400 with its line-height tightened to 16px in #222222, and a heart plus supporter count in Circular 12px #717171. Cards rotate a few degrees (estimated) and bleed off the viewport edges. The tilt is intentional — the hero reads as a desk of notes rather than a testimonial grid.

### Product Mockup Card

**Role:** Main content card demonstrating features

The workhorse surface. It uses a #ffffff background, no border, 32px radius, 24px padding, the md shadow, and the title "Buy Juliet a coffee" in Circular 24px weight 700 #222222. Its interior holds an 8px-radius textarea on #2222220d and a full-width support button. Each feature section centers one of these with satellite bubbles around it. The large radius against the 16px creator cards signals "this is the product" rather than "these are people using it".

### Mockup Support Button — Ember (System Outlier)

**Role:** Creator-page CTA inside demos

The sanctioned off-budget color. It takes a #d8573f background, #ffffff label, no border, 9999px radius, 48px height, full card width, label in Circular 16px weight 700, and no shadow. It breaks the one-hue rule on purpose — it depicts a creator's customizable page, whose accent is not Buy Me a Coffee's yellow. It must stay inside a mockup card and never appear in page chrome.

**Role:** Multiplier picker inside support widget

A row of ringed counters. It sits in a #d8573f0d Ember Wash tray with a 1px #d8573f40 border (mockup-internal, not a system token) and an 8px radius. The selected circle fills solid #d8573f with #ffffff text, beside a coffee emoji and a "×" in #717171. It turns payment into counting cups — the demo sells the metaphor.

**Role:** Satellite proof points around mockups

A small floating receipt. It takes a #ffffff background, no border, 24px radius, 16px padding, and the sm shadow. The numeral ("753", "$244", "$1,500") sits in Circular 24px weight 700 #222222 above a label in Circular 12px #717171, with a thin line icon. These orbit the central card at staggered offsets, so each feature reads as live activity rather than a spec sheet.

**Role:** Membership plan preview, fanned trio

A cream-headed plan slip. It has a #ffffff body, no border, 32px radius, the md shadow, and 16px padding. A #faf8f0 Cream Tile illustration header uses an 8px radius. The title ("Pro membership") is set in Circular 16px weight 700 #222222, the price in Circular 12px #717171 and checklist rows in Circular 12px #222222. **Role:** Trust stamp above hero headline

A single centered credential. Five filled stars in green (estimated, decorative, not a system token) sit beside "Loved by 2,000,000+ creators" in Circular 16px weight 400 #222222, with 8px between stars and copy and no container, border or shadow. It sits 32px above the 96px headline — a review-site quotation borrowed as punctuation rather than decoration.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Spend #ffdd00 on exactly one filled action per viewport — the yellow capsule is the brand, and a second yellow element halves its pull.
- Set the hero headline in Circular weight 700 at 96px with -2.4px tracking and a 0.99 line-height — the near-solid block of letters is the page's identity.
- Open every section with a 16px weight 700 uppercase eyebrow tracked 2px in #717171, then a 64px weight 700 headline at -2px — this pairing is the non-negotiable section opener.
- Lift cards with the three-layer sm shadow (a 2px ring at 0.15 plus a 40px haze at 0.04) instead of a border — depth comes from atmosphere, not outlines.
- Keep #d8573f and #f7d046 inside product mockup cards with a 32px radius — they demonstrate a creator's page and stay quarantined from chrome.
- Round every action, avatar and input to 9999px and every product card to 32px — capsules act, soft rectangles hold content.
- Set body copy at weight 400 in #222222, 22px/1.5 for hero subtitles and 24px/1.333 for section intros — softened ink reads warmer than #000000 on white.

### Don't

- Don't color CTAs or links in a #1877f2-style blue — convention puts actions in blue, but here that blue is a third-party social mark and is not a system token.
- Don't wrap cards in a 1px #e1e1e1 border on top of the sm shadow — doubling the edge turns soft floating paper into boxed form fields.
- Don't set the 64px headline in weight 500 or at 0px tracking — loosened, lighter display type loses the dense, stamped quality that carries hierarchy.
- Don't paint whole sections in #faf8f0 — cream is rationed to illustration tiles (7 uses), and a cream page dilutes the white-and-ink contrast that frames the yellow.
- Don't make the brand's primary button #d8573f because the mockups use it — the brand owns one hue, and terracotta must never leave the demo.
- Don't square buttons off to 8px — the 9999px capsule is the action shape, and an 8px button reads as an image or input.
- Don't put the lg shadow (80px haze) on stat bubbles and nav elements — stacked large hazes fog the white canvas and flatten the floating hierarchy.

## Elevation

- **Floating creator cards, stat bubbles, testimonial bubbles:** `0px 0px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 2px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`
- **Product mockup cards and tier cards:** `0px 0px 3px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 11px 56px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 3px 7px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`
- **Hero-scaled feature cards at 2x display scale:** `0px 0px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0px 16px 80px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`

All three are one recipe scaled. A tight 0.15 ring defines the edge, a wide 0.04 haze gives lift and a 0.05 contact shadow grounds it. The measured fractional variants (2.237px, 7.821px) come from CSS transforms applied to the same base, not from separate tokens.

## Imagery

There is no photography beyond small circular avatars. The imagery is the product itself, rendered as live-looking UI mockups: the support widget, the e-book storefront card and the membership tier fan. Mockups sit on #ffffff cards at a 32px radius with the md shadow and no borders, each orbited by stat and testimonial bubbles. Supporting art is flat vector illustration with thick dark outlines and saturated reds, yellows and teals (an envelope, a gift, a globe, an open book). That art sits on #faf8f0 tiles or a #f7d046 block and is decorative, not system tokens. Emoji (💯, ❤️, 👋) float as 9999px badges. Icons are thin single-weight line glyphs: search, heart, chevron, truck, storefront and bank. There are no gradients, glows or orbs anywhere. The narrative is a creator's desk scattered with receipts of support.

## Layout

Content centers in a 936px column on the 1920px canvas, and the nav spans full width with 48px gutters (estimated). The hero is a centered stack: social proof line, 96px headline, 22px subtitle, 72px yellow pill and a 14px reassurance line. Six tilted creator cards bleed off both side edges around it. Every section after that repeats one centered module — 16px eyebrow, 64px headline, 24px intro, then a mockup cluster — separated by 96px gaps. Sections do not alternate left-right as convention dictates, and the rhythm comes from the repeated module on unbroken white. There is no logo row or pricing grid, and memberships use a three-card overlapping fan. The nav is filled #ffffff at 72px, with links on the left, the logo centered, and search, "Log in" and "Sign up" on the right. Its sticky behavior was not measured. The footer was not captured. At 375px, set the hero in heading-sm at 40px, drop section gaps to 48px and hide satellite bubbles. Density: spacious.

## Mockup Color Quarantine

The discipline is that the brand's chrome owns one hue, #ffdd00, while every other saturated color lives inside a product demonstration. Terracotta #d8573f on the "Support $3" button and sand #f7d046 on the e-book cover show that a creator's page can wear any accent, while the surrounding nav, headlines and CTAs stay ink, white and yellow. Two moves would break it: lifting #d8573f into a real page link or button, or tinting a section background with illustration colors. Either one blurs the line between "our product" and "your page". To extend the system, place new accent colors only inside a 32px-radius mockup card with the md shadow. The card becomes a quarantine frame, so a new feature can introduce any hue without touching the chrome.

## Weight-Carried Hierarchy

Hierarchy on this page comes from Circular Bold's density, not from color or decoration. The 96px and 64px headlines at weight 700 with -2.4px and -2px tracking are the loudest objects on the page. The next level down drops to 24px Regular, which makes a cliff rather than the gradual Major Third ladder most marketing sites build. Two things would break it: adding a mid-weight 40px subheading between section headline and intro, or coloring a headline word in #ffdd00 for emphasis, which turns the yellow into decoration. To extend the system, add new levels only by changing size and weight together, using steps from the type scale. Keep the 16px 2px-tracked eyebrow as the single small, spaced label.

## Similar Brands

- **Ko-fi** — The same creator-tipping category built on a coffee-cup metaphor with capsule CTAs and floating supporter cards, though Ko-fi leads with a blue-and-red palette instead of a lone yellow.
- **Patreon** — Shares membership tiers presented as fanned plan cards and creator avatars as social proof, but sets display type in a condensed editorial face on darker grounds.
- **Gumroad** — The same digital-goods storefront demonstrated through product mockup cards, though Gumroad uses hard black borders and offset shadows where this site uses soft three-layer haze.
- **Spotify** — Uses the same Circular typeface in its Bold cut with tight negative tracking at display sizes and 9999px pill buttons as the dominant action shape.
- **Airbnb** — Uses a Circular-derived geometric sans, the same softened ink text color against white, and soft hazy shadows on rounded cards instead of hairline borders.
